known_limitations: OIDC token verification is available but experimental; identity provider configuration, token lifetimes, and review remain deployment-owned.
Process sandbox mode is not an operating-system security boundary.
Iceberg, Polaris, the MCP client, and remote gateways require protected deployment evidence before stable support.
Per-user and per-tenant period budgets require an external shared gateway or coordinator.
The reference audit collector needs deployment-managed TLS, immutable retention, and external chain anchoring.
The declared recovery targets require validation in each organization's managed environment.
OAP and AGS are aligned to pinned 1.0.1 schemas and conformance fixtures but remain experimental Loro product surfaces until the 1.0 compatibility promise is promoted.
Stable Web UI support covers the loopback, launch-token, single-user mode only; OIDC sign-in, non-loopback binding and multi-user use are experimental.
Stable MCP support covers Loro's MCP server (read-only tool exports, resources, prompts) at protocol revision 2025-11-25; the MCP client and the 2026-07-28 revision are experimental.
